format: DexDrive .n64: "123-456-STD" and a 0x1040-byte header (DexPlorer comments), then a 32 KiB Controller Pak with one GameShark cart-save note "SMSM" (3BADD1E5/FADE), 2 pages = the 4 Kbit EEPROM; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/n64-dexdrive.py convert super-mario-64.1091.n64 OUT: dexdrive: pak = the 32768 bytes after the 0x1040-byte header; ID block checksums 0101/FEFD wrong in every copy, rewritten as 0101/FEF1; cart-save note 'SMSM' (GameShark 3BADD1E5/FADE): raw EEPROM, 512 bytes

converted_standalone.how: the same bytes as the .srm regions, as standalone Mupen64Plus keeps them: <GoodName (32 chars)>-<MD5 8>.eep/.sra/.fla/.mpk in its save folder
